values.description: To act on personal moral principles even when faced with pressure to do otherwise.
Driven to complete projects and accomplish something noteworthy.
Adjusting readily to changing conditions.
Exercising given authority to complete specific management tasks.
Expressing fondness by touching. (Child and Elderly Care)
Experiencing intense pleasure through the inherent value of natural and person-made creations.
The exercise of personal power as straightforward expression of feelings and thoughts
Experiencing affirmation by peers.
Acting interdependently from the awareness of personal limitations, skills and know-how.

Consciously supporting family, friends and work-mates, and being emotionally supported by them.
Cooperating interdependently with personnel at all levels through appropriately delegating responsibility.
Transmitting ideas and factual data between people and components of an organization.
Committing to a group or team to maximize both independent creativity and interdependent cooperation.

To be energized by creating and improving the organization, its quality and management efficiency.

Sharing and applying new and original ideas and thoughts.

Applying creative design through art, ideas or technology.
The regular discipline of non-attachment that leads to quality relationships with others.
Skills in physical and mental coordination.
Enabling group consensus through openness, reflection, and honest interaction.
Loyalty to managers, peers and the organization, its customs and regulations,

To contribute to ecological balance through creative technology.
Completing a formal learning program

To do critical path planning that maximizes output and minimizes waste.
Listening and responding to others so they see themselves with more clarity. Seeing and feeling their concerns and issues as they do.
Handling difficult and painful tasks with calm and perseverance.

Maintaining status quo by managing conflicts.
Ensuring that all employees and peers are treated fairly.

Being sensitive to the limitations of others and using one&#;s unique gifts and skills to help them without expecting something in return.
Promoting quality of life internationally by influencing positive change relative to equality, conflict resolution and ecology.

Enabling the organization to develop appropriate growth strategies.
Engaging in ongoing preventative health practices that are sound such as diet, exercise and relaxation.
Being able to understand and manage bureaucracy.
To promote respect and loyalty to people in authority.
Promoting an organizational environment where everyone is respected and have their basic needs met so they can develop their full potential.

Thinking and acting for oneself without being constrained by external authority.
Harmonizing the mind and body.
Giving preference to cooperation, both personal and inter-organizational, over independent action.
Sharing thoughts, feelings and fantasies, mutually and freely, regularly with another person.
Experiencing inner harmony that results from meditation, mutual openness and acceptance of another person.
Acting to addresses, confront and correct conditions of human oppression.
Pursuing truth through patterned investigation and use of intuition as a basis for decision making.
Using the rules and regulations as guidelines, rather than directives for decision making.
Living by the rules established by the legal system.
Engaging in highly skilled activities that totally detach you from the stress of work and increase your overall creativity.
Recognizing personal inabilities as a beginning point for problem solving and growth.
Laughing at one&#;s imperfections as a way of defining one&#;s unique skills and talents.
Duty to friends and to those in authority and friends even when it is to your disadvantage.

Taking complex ideas from different sources and converting them into simplified, practical technology that improves society.

Being equally responsible for establishing a group&#;s rules and following them.

Positive experience of the senses and the body as a whole. (Health Care)
Giving leadership through pioneering new creative ideas.
Placing a priority on playful relaxation as essential to the quality of your relationships and work.

Appearing successful to gain the esteem of others.
To be energized by completing and achieving personal and group tasks and goals.
Skills in managing property and finances.
The ability to raise the awareness and activities of others to the subject of global human issues.

Seeing simplicity in complexity, as a basis for decision making, leadership and lifestyle.

To give and receive from one's peers even in difficult times.

Recognizing and celebrating personal, cultural company and national history.
